[[Su]] is a [[necromancer]] instructor in [[Shing Jea Monastery]]. She is [[Headmaster Kuju]]'s granddaughter, [[Reng Ku]]'s sister, and is [[Old Friends, Dark Times#Dialogue|in a relationship]] with [[Jinzo]]. She is available as a [[henchman]] in some parts of [[Cantha]].

She is labeled as a "Grave Henchman".

==Evaluation==
;Pros
*Exploits [[corpse]]s, preventing foes from using them.
*Effective [[self heal]].
*The only [[minion master]] henchman in the game.
*Has effective damage on top of minions.
;Cons
*Minion skills have long recharges and Su possesses no method of healing the minions.
*Exploits corpses, preventing other allies from using them.
*Cannot cause conditions, making Vile Miasma much less useful.

==Dialogue==
;Panjiang Peninsula (to [[Factions]] [[necromancer]] characters):
:''"Oh, good! Just what this monastery needs: more necromancer novices. As if I have time for the students I already have. Do you not know that a powerful Necromancer has more important things to do?"''

;Panjiang Peninsula (to Factions non-necromancer characters):
:''"You are lucky that you are not a Necromancer-in-training. I do not allow my apprentices to wander about anywhere they like. Go and find your [[headmaster]]."''

;Panjiang Peninsula (to non-Factions characters):
:''"I am afraid I cannot help you. You are not a student here. And do not bother trying to become one... that honor is reserved for [[Cantha]]ns."''

;Haiju Lagoon:
:''"Make yourself useful or I will find a use for your corpse."''

;Shing Jea Island:
:''"This plague is a real work of art. I don't know who created it, but whoever it was certainly knew what they were doing. Not only does the plague kill, but it also [[Sickened|inflicts insanity]] upon its victims, leading to them bursting open and spawning an [[Afflicted|unholy abomination]]. I only wish I'd have thought of it. What do you want?"''

;Kaineng City:
:''"It is strange to be away from all of those I care about and to be surrounded by so many I have little use for. Death is a part of life. Many in this city should welcome it with open arms the way they are forced to live their lives.''

:''What do you want?"''

;Divine Path:
:''"I think it is time to settle down after all of this. Perhaps I will go find a nice dark hollow somewhere in [[Echovald Forest|Echovald]]."''

==Quotes==
;Shing Jea Island:
:''"If I had wanted to stand around and do nothing for long periods of time I could have visited Reng Ku."''

;Kaineng City:
:''"Grandmother would have something to say about the sorry state of this city."''
:''"[[Jinzo]] has such lovely eyes."''
:''"Reng Ku should have come, not me. He could put up with sitting around much easier than I."''

==Trivia==
*''"Your soul is mine"'' is a quote used during a fatality move in the game Mortal Kombat by the necromancer Shang Tsung.  This was also portrayed in the 1995 movie Mortal Kombat.
*The [[Game updates/20091022|22nd October 2009 update]] updated her skills and changed her label from "Vile Henchman" to "Grave Henchman".
**This added [[Animate Flesh Golem]] (elite), [[Animate Vampiric Horror]], [[Taste of Death]], and [[Vile Miasma]], and removed [[Lingering Curse]] (elite), [[Soul Feast]], and [[Vile Touch]] from her skills.
